knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=The enrichment method to use ("AUCell", "GSVA", "ssGSEA", or "UCell") ;; groups=The number of cells to calculate at once ;; min.size=The minimum size of detectable genes in a gene set to keep it ;; new.assay.name=The custom assay name to save enrichment scores in the single-cell object ;; make.positive=Whether to shift enrichment values to a positive range during normalization (useful for downstream log2-fold change calculations, but alters score interpretation) ;; scale.factor=A vector of scaling factors (e.g., nFeature_RNA) to scale enrichment scores by expressed gene sets ;; ranking_fun=The function used to rank genes in enrichIt (e.g., "signed_log10_p")
- alternatives: msigdbr=An alternative R package to access MSigDB with expanded species support and faster access without local caching ;; Seurat's RunPCA or scater's runPCA=Faster PCA alternatives to performPCA for larger datasets with many cells or gene sets
- when_to_use: Use when you want to calculate per-cell gene-set enrichment scores directly from single-cell RNA-seq count matrices or single-cell containers, or when you want to perform classical GSEA on precomputed differential expression results using ranked gene lists.
- pitfalls: make.positive=TRUE modifies the raw enrichment values and should be used with caution as it alters the enrichment score interpretation ;; Single-cell drop-out can cause inherent bias in enrichment values (cells with more features/counts have higher scores), so normalization via performNormalization() is highly recommended ;; getGeneSets() downloads a complete local copy of MSigDB on its first run, which can take a long time.

workflows.name: per_cell_enrichment_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Calculate per-cell gene set enrichment scores directly on a single-cell object, normalize for drop-out, and perform downstream visualization and statistical analysis.
input: sc_data.rds (Seurat or SingleCellExperiment object containing raw single-cell RNA-seq counts)
gene_sets.rds (A list of gene sets or a GSEABase GeneSetCollection object)
workflows.stages: 1. Calculate enrichment scores and attach them to the single-cell object using runEscape ;; 2. Normalize enrichment scores to account for drop-out bias using performNormalization ;; 3. Visualize enrichment scores using heatmapEnrichment, geyserEnrichment, ridgeEnrichment, splitEnrichment, gseaEnrichment, densityEnrichment, or scatterEnrichment ;; 4. Perform PCA on enrichment scores using performPCA and visualize with pcaEnrichment ;; 5. Perform differential enrichment analysis using FindAllMarkers on normalized scores.
workflows.code:
pbmc_small <- runEscape(pbmc_small, 
                        method = "ssGSEA",
                        gene.sets = escape.gene.sets, 
                        groups = 1000, 
                        min.size = 3,
                        new.assay.name = "escape.ssGSEA")

sce.pbmc <- runEscape(sce.pbmc, 
                      method = "UCell",
                      gene.sets = escape.gene.sets, 
                      groups = 1000, 
                      min.size = 5,
                      new.assay.name = "escape.UCell")

pbmc_small <- performNormalization(input.data = pbmc_small, 
                                   assay = "escape.ssGSEA", 
                                   gene.sets = escape.gene.sets)

pbmc_small <- performNormalization(input.data = pbmc_small, 
                                   assay = "escape.ssGSEA", 
                                   gene.sets = escape.gene.sets, 
                                   scale.factor = pbmc_small$nFeature_RNA)

heatmapEnrichment(pbmc_small, 
                  group.by = "ident",
                  gene.set.use = "all",
                  assay = "escape.ssGSEA")

heatmapEnrichment(sce.pbmc, 
                  group.by = "ident",
                  assay = "escape.UCell",
                  scale = TRUE,
                  cluster.rows = TRUE,
                  cluster.columns = TRUE)

heatmapEnrichment(pbmc_small, 
                  assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                  palette = "Spectral") 

heatmapEnrichment(sce.pbmc, 
                  group.by = "ident",
                  assay = "escape.UCell") + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))) 

geyserEnrichment(pbmc_small,
                 assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                 gene.set.use = "T1-Interferon")

geyserEnrichment(pbmc_small,
                 assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                 gene.set.use = "T1-Interferon",
                 order.by = "mean")

geyserEnrichment(pbmc_small,
                 assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                 gene.set.use = "T1-Interferon",
                 facet.by = "groups")

geyserEnrichment(pbmc_small,
                 assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                 gene.set.use = "T1-Interferon",
                 color.by  = "T1-Interferon")

ridgeEnrichment(sce.pbmc,
                assay = "escape.UCell",
                gene.set.use = "T2_Interferon")

ridgeEnrichment(sce.pbmc,
                assay = "escape.UCell",
                gene.set.use = "T2_Interferon",
                add.rug = TRUE,
                scale = TRUE)

splitEnrichment(pbmc_small,
                assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                gene.set.use = "Lipid-mediators",
                split.by = "groups")

splitEnrichment(pbmc_small,
                assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                gene.set.use = "Lipid-mediators",
                split.by = "ident",
                group.by = "groups")

gseaEnrichment(pbmc_small,
               gene.set.use = "T2_Interferon",
               gene.sets    = escape.gene.sets,
               group.by     = "ident",
               summary.fun  = "mean",
               nperm        = 1000)

# densityEnrichment(pbmc_small,
#                   gene.set.use = "T2_Interferon",
#                   gene.sets = escape.gene.sets)

scatterEnrichment(pbmc_small, 
                  assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                  x.axis = "T2-Interferon",
                  y.axis = "Lipid-mediators")

scatterEnrichment(sce.pbmc, 
                  assay = "escape.UCell",
                  x.axis = "T2_Interferon",
                  y.axis = "Lipid_mediators",
                  style = "hex")

pbmc_small <- performPCA(pbmc_small, 
                         assay = "escape.ssGSEA",
                         n.dim = 1:10)

pcaEnrichment(pbmc_small, 
              dimRed = "escape.PCA",
              x.axis = "PC1",
              y.axis = "PC2")

pcaEnrichment(pbmc_small, 
              dimRed = "escape.PCA",
              x.axis = "PC1",
              y.axis = "PC2",
              add.percent.contribution = TRUE,
              display.factors = TRUE,
              number.of.factors = 10)

pbmc_small <- performNormalization(pbmc_small, 
                                   assay = "escape.ssGSEA", 
                                   gene.sets = escape.gene.sets,
                                   make.positive = TRUE)

all.markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc_small, 
                              assay = "escape.ssGSEA_normalized", 
                              min.pct = 0,
                              logfc.threshold = 0)

workflows.name: gsea_on_precomputed_deg
workflows.intent: Perform classical GSEA on precomputed differential expression results using ranked gene lists and visualize the output.
input: deg_results.csv (A data frame of differential expression results containing logFC and p-values, e.g., from FindMarkers, DESeq2, or edgeR)
gene_sets.rds (A list of gene sets or a GSEABase GeneSetCollection object)
workflows.stages: 1. Run GSEA on the ranked differential expression results using enrichIt ;; 2. Visualize GSEA results using enrichItPlot to generate bar, dot, or cnet plots.
workflows.code:
DEG.markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc_small, 
                           ident.1 = "0", 
                           ident.2 = "1")

GSEA.results <- enrichIt(input.data = DEG.markers, 
                         gene.sets = escape.gene.sets, 
                         ranking_fun = "signed_log10_p")               

head(GSEA.results)

## (1) Bar plot –20 most significant per database
enrichItPlot(GSEA.results)               

## (2) Dot plot – coloured by –log10 padj, sized by core-hits
enrichItPlot(GSEA.results, "dot", top = 10) 

## (3) C-net plot – network of pathways ↔ leading-edge genes
enrichItPlot(GSEA.results, "cnet", top = 5)
